gates.name: transaction-and-arrival
gates.pass: each required first-contact carrier has a concrete arrived object identity
required: source/seller and transaction evidence
exact ordered SKU where identity is load-bearing
arrival timestamp
photo or equivalent bounded physical evidence
package/accessory completeness and visible-damage check

gates.name: physical-object-identity
gates.pass: future evidence can refer to the exact objects used rather than product classes
required: Pico 2 physical identity sufficient to distinguish the selected board from spares
AD3 exact model/SKU + serial or manufacturer-native unique identity if exposed
UT61E+ or replacement reference exact physical identity
component lot/object labels for candidate resistors and selected film capacitor

gates.name: node-attachment-binding
gates.pass: Workstation can project the current local physical attachment/binding without claiming calibration or experiment validity
gates.pressure: This is the first concrete consumer for the Workstation future-USB-instrument responsibility. Implement the smallest owner-native projection only after real device arrival reveals actual endpoint/driver semantics.
required: current local attachment/endpoint enumeration for Pico 2 when connected
current local attachment/endpoint/driver binding for AD3 when connected
driver/provider identity needed to address each device
binding currentness observed from the execution node

gates.name: programmable-carrier-generation
gates.pass: the exact programmable generation can be reconstructed/re-entered
required: Pico 2 firmware/source artifact digest and build/flash/re-entry recipe
AD3 WaveForms/runtime/SDK generation actually used, plus callable acquisition path
device firmware version where exposed and decision-relevant
reconnect/rebind smoke receipt after one deliberate disconnect or process restart if safe

gates.name: manual-static-reference-fitness
gates.pass: static reveal path is valid and comfortably discriminates the two resistor classes
required: UT61E+ or replacement reference basic continuity/DC/resistance fitness check
range/mode used for post-classification resistor reveal
documented reason this path is adequate for distinguishing ~1 kOhm from ~4.7 kOhm; no universal calibration claim required

gates.name: component-and-assembly-admission
gates.pass: the physical network lies inside the preregistered component/tolerance envelope before classification data are collected
required: 1 kOhm and 4.7 kOhm candidates documented <=1% or independently measured before blinding by the preparation side
selected 1 uF film capacitor documented <=10% or separately admitted before blinding
breadboard/leads visually inspected and continuity/plausibility checked
shared ground/reference topology documented
no resistor/capacitor power/voltage rating violation under Pico 3.3 V excitation

gates.name: blinding-and-information-boundary
gates.pass: classification cannot be replaced by reading the component label/inventory truth
required: one preparation-side record binds opaque candidateObjectId to physical resistor identity before waveform capture
classification-side context receives candidateObjectId and allowed setup metadata but not resistor value/label/source record
reveal record remains inaccessible to classifier until classification receipt is committed
same physical capacitor is used across A/B candidates when practical, or capacitor identity is separately frozen per candidate

gates.name: measurement-path-admission
gates.pass: waveform is valid enough for the bounded A-vs-B time-constant decision
required: AD3 captures physical Vin and Vout simultaneously
sample rate >= 1,000,000 samples/s
input range/coupling/channel mapping recorded
raw unrounded waveform retained
pre/post levels and edge window sufficient to compute normalized t63
observed signal remains within provider input limits
measurement path shows no clipping/obvious saturation/dropout or unresolved aliasing that could move t63 across preregistered bands

gates.name: low-energy-operation-admission
gates.pass: E0-B remains a bounded low-energy bench experiment
required: Pico GPIO is the only experiment excitation unless contract is revised before data
nominal low-voltage 0↔3.3 V regime
common reference/ground topology checked before connection
no mains, bench PSU, soldering, custom PCB or E1 mechanics required by this experiment
all instrument connections stay inside documented input/output limits

gates.name: measurement-information-baseline
gates.pass: the active dynamic condition adds the intended discriminating information rather than merely repeating a static answer
required: before time-series data are exposed, blinded classifier commits STATIC_AMBIGUOUS from admitted static-only evidence
if static-only evidence unexpectedly uniquely distinguishes A/B, mark EXPERIMENT_ASSUMPTION_FALSIFIED and do not claim active information gain
captured Vin 10-90% rise time <=44.55 us for the simple-step t63 classifier

gates.name: classification-commit
gates.pass: classification exists independently of physical resistor identity reveal
required: derive t63 from normalized measured output using captured pre/post levels
compare only against already-frozen bands A=0.891–1.111 ms and B=4.188–5.222 ms
commit exactly one of MODEL_A / MODEL_B / MODEL_OR_MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH / MEASUREMENT_NOT_ADMITTED before reveal

gates.name: reveal-and-bridge-adjudication
gates.pass: bounded synthetic↔physical bridge may be admitted only when measurement was admitted and pre-reveal model classification agrees with post-reveal identity
required: post-classification reveal binds candidateObjectId to resistor identity/static-reference result
compare classification with reveal without retuning model parameters
retain mismatch as a first-class negative consequence
retain synthetic prediction, physical waveform, measurement-validity standing, classification and reveal as separate referenced artifacts

minimumArrivedPhysicalSet: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 with headers / SC1632 x1
Digilent Analog Discovery 3 Pro Bundle / 471-060 x1
UNI-T UT61E+ x1 or separately admitted equivalent static reference
nonClaims: not a guarantee the preregistered RC model will match Reality
purpose: Define the evidence gates that convert purchased/arrived objects into one admissible E0-B physical execution without creating a generic device registry or silently promoting asset presence into measurement validity.
reentryTrigger: Reopen physical execution only when G0/G1 evidence exists for the minimum arrived physical set. Do not schedule or poll for arrival here; re-observe actual owner/source evidence when the user reports delivery or another current inventory carrier appears.
